text: (1) Academic and Age Requirements Applicants for a bachelor's degree should have completed high school education with excellent academic performance and generally be under 25 years old. Applicants for a master's degree should have a bachelor's degree or equivalent, with excellent academic performance and generally be under 35 years old. Applicants for a doctoral degree should have a master's degree or equivalent, with excellent academic performance and generally be under 40 years old. (2) Complete application in RUC system Students applying for the "Silk Road" scholarship must have submitted their application through the Renmin University of China International Student Application System and have been admitted by RUC as self-support students.
